scope: TEST sealed capability boundary, not 46-class currentness proof

capabilities.definition: Bypass SQL ownership/ACL/catalog checks; provisioner only, then NOLOGIN/password NULL/HBA reject.
Alter database and implicit pg_database_owner/public ownership; postgres remains owner, inactive.
Change protected role attributes; no active CREATEROLE/SUPERUSER identity.
Enter protected owner; only broker may SET control_owner, without ADMIN or INHERIT.
Create/replace name-resolution candidates; public implicit database owner is disabled postgres.
Alter protected relation/columns/constraints/indexes/triggers/row types; control ownership is private to broker.
Change function definition/context; each actual owner is enumerated in database-census ownership.
Change protected types and generated row/array types; actual owners are enumerated.
Change effective SQL grants; private owner capability or disabled postgres, no ordinary grant paths.
Change defaults for a protected creating role; explicit FOR ROLE retains historical target.
Transfer database owner; current postgres owner has no active qualification login.
Add protected membership; no active role ADMIN option/CREATEROLE/SUPERUSER.
Write protected policy/binding/READY rows; all ordinary DML and source execution paths revoked.
Write protected SQL audit rows or external qualification journal; distinct controlled writer/worker processes.
Append/truncate/replace module and library paths; readonly roots, parents and module mounts.
Restart enrolled participant; only broker-signed increasing-generation delegate API.
Replace interpreter/PG/native executable or libraries; readonly pinned images and mounts.
Docker daemon, host filesystem, mounts, namespaces or host root; explicitly pre-existing HOST_PLATFORM trust boundary.
Write durable epoch/journal; private broker volume and immutable closed coordinator API.
Write generation; same private broker volume, no campaign/native mount or reset API.
Modify PostgreSQL builtin/operator/cast/access-method catalogs; SQL privilege checks, disabled superuser.
Change ICU/libc/extension/PG providers; readonly source image, protected module, HOST_PLATFORM outside.
Replace source/expected manifest/recipe bytes; trusted release HOST files outside actors, active code mounted readonly.
Change another protected consuming backend session; private broker connection, no arbitrary SQL/session API.
Change retained/protected rows or Flyway history; cataloged ownership, no ordinary DML/source-wrapper execution.
Change native epoch/identity/nonce/generation proof; immutable delegate plus private broker-authenticated transition.
Change SQL collation definition/version; protected catalog/source owner inactive unless control owner, via broker only.
Change expression/view/default dependency definitions; table/function/type/catalog ownership checks.
Change native loader/environment/locale; immutable fixed executable/env, participant exec/fork/signal seccomp denial.
Change protected storage, TOAST or index identities; SQL owner checks and trusted immutable PG engine.
